name: Day in my life (product as the thread)
mechanism: Show the product at 4-5 ordinary moments of one day; each moment pairs one real routine with one verified feature, so the product reads as part of how the day works.

hook.pattern: POV / first-person statement about the whole day revolving around one object, phrased as a confession, not an ad
examples: POV: satu hari full, semua urusanku lewat HP ini
Ternyata yang paling sering kupegang seharian ya ini

beats.guidance: Strongest product shot, on-screen POV line, narration a casual confession.
Morning moment (wake up / commute). Label like '06.30 · Pagi'. One feature only.
Midday moment (work / lunch / errands). Label with time. One feature only.
Afternoon/evening moment (sunset, hangout, content). Label with time. One feature only.
Night moment (wind down / charging). Label with time. Ties the day together.
Soft recommendation, no hard sell, point to the product link.

cta: Soft: 'aku taruh linknya di bawah' style
